comboData.title: Alien FTK: Premature Burial Loop into Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter
comboData.description: A three-card first-turn kill. Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns your face-up Spells to your hand and places an A-Counter for each one, so Premature Burial revives Gol'gar over and over while Code A Ancient Ruins spends the counters to bring Alien Ammonite back. Each revival opens a new Synchro or Link Summon: Nothung burns 800, Worldsea Dragon Zealantis resets every monster, and Geonator Transverser gives your opponent Ancient Sacred Wyvern. The 7200 LP you spend on Burials pumps that Wyvern to 8500 ATK under their control, and Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech burns them for the 6400 difference. Dark Strike Fighter Tributes itself for the last 1400. Your opponent never gets a turn. Starting hand: Alien Ammonite + Unexpected Dai + Premature Burial. Deck: Alien Shocktrooper, Code A Ancient Ruins, Black Garden. Extra Deck: Gol'gar, M-Frame, Zer'oll, Nothung, Ancient Sacred Wyvern, Zealantis, Garden Rose Maiden, Geonator Transverser, Saryuja Skull Dread, Muddy Mudragon, Dark Strike Fighter, Machu Mech. A hand trap that stops Gol'gar or Premature Burial ends the loop, and you finish on 800 LP.

steps.text: Activate Unexpected Dai. You control no monsters, so it can bring a Level 4 or lower Normal Monster out of your Deck.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai resolves and goes to the Graveyard.
Normal Summon Alien Ammonite. Its trigger has no Alien in the Graveyard to revive yet, so let it pass.
Alien Shocktrooper becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material. Gol'gar has to use Alien Ammonite as its Tuner, plus non-Tuner Alien monsters.
Synchro Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar (Level 1 + Level 4). This is the engine of the whole turn: it bounces your face-up Spells back to your hand and turns each one into an A-Counter.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (you: 7200) and target Alien Ammonite in your Graveyard.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite in Attack Position. Premature Burial stays on the field, attached to it.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return face-up Premature Burial to your hand and place 1 A-Counter on a monster. Burial leaves without being destroyed, so Ammonite stays.
Premature Burial returns to your hand, ready to be played again.
Alien Ammonite becomes Link Material.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes the second Reptile material.
Link Summon Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame (2 Reptile monsters).
Activate Premature Burial again: pay 800 LP (6400) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. It came out properly the first time, so it can be revived.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. It is a new card on the field, so its once-per-turn effect is fresh. Return Premature Burial and place 1 A-Counter.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame becomes Link Material. As a Link-2 it counts as 2.
Link Summon Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll (Link-3, 2+ Reptile monsters).
Activate effect: Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll's on-summon effect. Add a card from your Deck that has an effect that places A-Counters.
Add Code A Ancient Ruins to your hand. It gains an A-Counter whenever a face-up Alien is destroyed, so it qualifies.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins, a Continuous Spell.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (5600) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.

Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins, so you place 2 A-Counters. This is the loop: every Burial revives Gol'gar, and every Gol'gar pays for the next Code A.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand. Once you activate it again it is a new card, so its once-per-turn effect resets.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins again.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove the 2 A-Counters Gol'gar just placed to bring back an Alien from your Graveyard.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight (Level 5 + Level 1).
Activate effect: Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight was Special Summoned. Inflict 800 damage to your opponent (8000 to 7200). They control no monsters, so the ATK loss does nothing.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (4800) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 more A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material. Ancient Sacred Wyvern needs a LIGHT Tuner, and Ammonite is LIGHT.
Synchro Summon Ancient Sacred Wyvern (Level 6 + Level 1). Its ATK goes up or down by the gap between its controller's LP and the other player's LP. Keep an eye on it: it becomes the finisher.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Cosmic Slicer Zer'oll becomes Link Material. As a Link-3 it counts as 3.
Link Summon Worldsea Dragon Zealantis (Link-4, 1+ Effect Monsters).
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (4000) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Worldsea Dragon Zealantis. Banish every monster on the field, then bring back as many of them as possible. Each one returns as a new card, so Gol'gar's effect is fresh again.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern is banished.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar is banished.
Alien Ammonite is banished.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis banishes itself too.
Zealantis Special Summons Alien Ammonite back from banishment.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern returns. It came out properly the first time, so it can come back.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis returns to a Main Monster Zone, which frees the Extra Monster Zone for later.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (3200) and target Alien Shocktrooper.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial and Code A Ancient Ruins for 2 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Alien Shocktrooper becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Garden Rose Maiden (Level 1 + Level 4).
Activate effect: Garden Rose Maiden was Special Summoned. Add Black Garden from your Deck.
Add Black Garden to your hand.

Activate Black Garden. From now on, each monster summoned face-up has its ATK halved, and its controller gives the other player a Rose Token. The tokens you give away appear on your opponent's field, which this board doesn't show.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Ammonite's ATK is halved and you give your opponent Rose Token 1.
Alien Ammonite becomes Link Material.
Worldsea Dragon Zealantis becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Geonator Transverser (2 Effect Monsters). Its bottom-left arrow points at Ancient Sacred Wyvern, and its top-right arrow points at a Rose Token on your opponent's side.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Geonator's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 2.
Activate effect: Geonator Transverser. It points to 2 monsters, so switch control of Ancient Sacred Wyvern and that Rose Token.
Ancient Sacred Wyvern moves to your opponent's field. From now on its ATK rises by their LP minus yours, and each Premature Burial widens that gap.
You take control of the Rose Token.
The Rose Token becomes Link Material. A Token used as material simply ceases to exist.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Link Material.
Geonator Transverser becomes Link Material. As a Link-2 it counts as 2.

Link Summon Saryuja Skull Dread (Link-4) with 3 materials that have different names. Three materials give it two effects: monsters summoned to zones it points to gain 300 ATK/DEF, and once per turn it can Special Summon a monster from your hand.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Saryuja's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 3.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (2400) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate effect: Black Garden. Gol'gar's ATK is halved and your opponent gets Rose Token 4.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Gol'gar arrived in a zone it points to, so Gol'gar gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial, Code A Ancient Ruins and Black Garden: 3 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Black Garden returns to your hand. With it gone, your next summons don't hand out Rose Tokens.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes Synchro Material.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Muddy Mudragon (Level 5 + Level 1).
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Muddy Mudragon gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate Premature Burial: pay 800 LP (1600) and target Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Special Summon Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar.
Activate Black Garden again. Gol'gar is already on the field, so it isn't halved, and Black Garden gives Gol'gar a third face-up card to return.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar. Return Premature Burial, Code A Ancient Ruins and Black Garden for 3 A-Counters.
Premature Burial returns to your hand.
Code A Ancient Ruins returns to your hand.
Black Garden returns to your hand.
Activate Code A Ancient Ruins.
Activate effect: Code A Ancient Ruins. Remove 2 A-Counters.
Special Summon Alien Ammonite from your Graveyard.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Alien Ammonite gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Alien Ammonite becomes Synchro Material.
Muddy Mudragon becomes Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Dark Strike Fighter (Level 1 + Level 6). In Main Phase 1 it can Tribute a monster to burn for that monster's Level x 200.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Dark Strike Fighter gains 300 ATK/DEF.

Activate Premature Burial one last time: pay 800 LP and target Alien Shocktrooper. You are down to 800 LP while your opponent is still on 7200, so the Wyvern they control is at 2100 + 6400 = 8500 ATK.
Special Summon Alien Shocktrooper.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Alien Shocktrooper gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar's second effect. Remove 2 A-Counters to destroy 1 card your opponent controls: one of the Rose Tokens.
Xyz Summon Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech (2 Level 5 monsters).
Garden Rose Maiden becomes Xyz Material.
Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar becomes the second material.
Activate effect: Saryuja Skull Dread. Machu Mech gains 300 ATK/DEF.
Activate effect: Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech. Target Ancient Sacred Wyvern on your opponent's field: its original ATK is 2100 and its current ATK is 8500.
Detach Garden Rose Maiden as the cost.
Machu Mech inflicts the 6400 difference as damage (your opponent: 7200 to 800) and gains that much ATK.
Activate effect: Garden Rose Maiden in your Graveyard. Banish it and target a Dragon Synchro Monster in your Graveyard.
Banish Garden Rose Maiden as the cost.
Special Summon Muddy Mudragon from your Graveyard. The replay does this before the last burn, but the duel is already won without it.
Activate effect: Dark Strike Fighter. It is still Main Phase 1: Tribute a monster to inflict its Level x 200 as damage.
Tribute Dark Strike Fighter itself. It is Level 7, so your opponent takes 1400 damage with 800 LP left, and the duel ends on the first turn.

comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Nerva, Diactorus and an Impasto Hand-off
comboData.description: Going first with an Artmage build. Artmage Power Patron is the Power Patron card that lets Theorealized Medius Special Summon itself from the hand, and the Theorealize Liberation it adds calls Nervedo for Nerva. You pass with Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Artmage Graflare and Theorealized Medius (Illusion, Fairy and Dragon: three Monster Types) plus a set Artmage Impasto -Recapture-. On your opponent's turn, Impasto banishes Artmage Diactorus face-up until the End Phase. That banish triggers Theorealized Medius, which brings out a second Artmage Diactorus while the first is away. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius. Extra Deck: Nerva the Power Patron of Creation and 2 Artmage Diactorus.

Theorealize Liberation goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Nervedo, banishing the top 3 cards of your Deck face-down as the cost. Face-down banishes don't trigger Theorealized Medius.
Nervedo is destroyed. It's a Pendulum Monster, so it goes to your Extra Deck face-up.
Special Summon Nerva the Power Patron of Creation from your Extra Deck. This is treated as a Fusion Summon, which Artmage Power Patron's restriction allows.
Activate effect: Nervedo was added to your Extra Deck face-up.

Activate effect: Artmage Power Patron (Quick Effect).

Activate effect: Artmage Power Patron was sent from the field to the GY.
Add Artmage Impasto -Recapture- from your Deck to your hand. There's no card with that name in your GY.

Set Artmage Impasto -Recapture- and end your turn. Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Theorealized Medius and Graflare cover three Monster Types, so Diactorus's negation and Graflare's Quick Effect are both live.
Your opponent's turn. They activate a monster effect: activate Artmage Impasto -Recapture-.

Banish Artmage Diactorus until the End Phase. The activation is negated and that monster is destroyed. Nerva, Theorealized Medius and Graflare are still three Monster Types, so their Spells and Traps also return to the hand.
Artmage Impasto -Recapture- goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius. A monster was just banished face-up.
Banish Theorealized Medius.
Special Summon the second Artmage Diactorus from your Extra Deck. With Nerva and Graflare it still makes three Monster Types, so its negation is live again this turn.
End Phase: the first Artmage Diactorus returns to the field. You now have two.

comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Theorealize, a Self-Banish and Past Lull
comboData.description: A Medius build with two copies of Theorealized Medius and no Artmage cards in the Main Deck. Medius the Pure calls one copy from the Deck, and that copy is the Power Patron card the one in your hand needs. Theorealize sends a second Medius the Pure to the GY. That copy revives itself and is banished when it leaves the field, and the face-up banish triggers Theorealized Medius. The same Link Summon puts the other copy in the GY, which is what Purification Power Patron's search needs. You end on Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and a Medius the Pure your opponent couldn't respond to. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius.

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon a second Theorealized Medius from your Deck. It is always treated as a Power Patron card.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius in your hand. The copy on the field is a Power Patron card, and no copy has used this effect this turn.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your hand.
Add Theorealize from your Deck to your hand. Its name makes it a Theorealize Spell.
Activate Theorealize.
Send a second Medius the Pure from your Deck to the GY as the cost.
Theorealize resolves: look at the top card of your opponent's Deck and put it on the top or the bottom. Theorealize goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure in your GY. The first copy only used its summon effect, so this effect is still free.
Shuffle the first Medius the Pure from the field into your Deck. Past Lull will summon it again at the end.
Special Summon Medius the Pure from your GY. It will be banished when it leaves the field.
Send the Theorealized Medius that came from the Deck to the GY as material.
Use Medius the Pure as material too. It was summoned by its own effect, so it's banished face-up instead of going to the GY.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's summon trigger. The Theorealized Medius in your GY is a Power Patron monster.
In the same chain, activate effect: the Theorealized Medius still on the field. Medius the Pure was just banished face-up.
Theorealized Medius resolves first: banish it.
Special Summon Artmage Diactorus from your Extra Deck, into the zone below Purification Power Patron.
Purification Power Patron resolves: add Theorealize Past Lull from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Past Lull. Artmage Diactorus is an Artmage card, so its condition is met.
Theorealize Past Lull resolves: Special Summon Medius the Pure from your Deck. Your opponent can't respond to the summon. Its summon effect was already used this turn.
Theorealize Past Lull goes to the GY.

End board: Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and Medius the Pure. Medius is the other DARK Fairy that keeps Purification's Quick Effect live on your opponent's turn, and Past Lull's GY effect is ready for next turn.

comboData.title: Black Whirlwind Chain into a Six-Monster Synchro Board
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind-powered opening that chains Simoon the Poison Wind, Sudri the Phantom Glimmer, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering into a repeating Synchro engine. Nothung the Starlight and Boreastorm the Wicked Wind are Synchro Summoned and sent back to the Graveyard in sequence, using Black Feather Whirlwind and Zephyros the Elite to keep re-fueling the Whirlwind loop and pump out three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon. The line closes with Blackwing Full Armor Master, a second Black-Winged Dragon, and a second Nothung the Starlight rounding out a six-monster board, backed by Twin Shadow and Black Shadow Squall set in the Spell/Trap Zone. Heads-up: this line uses Crossout Designator, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind opening that converts Simoon the Poison Wind and Sudri the Phantom Glimmer into two Normal Summons in the same turn. The board finishes with Dis Pater, Nothung, a re-summoned Sudri and Blackwing - Twin Shadow active in the backrow.

comboData.title: Raptor Wing Strike Engine into Triple Assault Dragon and Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
comboData.description: An explosive Blackwing line utilizing Raptor Wing Strike to cycle Simoon the Poison Wind back to the Deck while Black Whirlwind fetches Sudri the Phantom Glimmer. The setup cascades into summoning three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon, before Blackwing - Twin Shadow recycles materials into Blackwing Full Armor Master and adds Chinook the Snow Blast to hand for quick-effect monster negation.

comboData.title: Pumpking's Eldlich Splash into The Undying Legion
comboData.description:
A one-card Pumpking opening that snowballs into the deck's full Eldlich package. Pumpking discards itself as the reveal cost to Set Call of the Haunted, then the Trap revives it immediately, netting Changshi the Spiridao from the Deck and milling Army of the Haunted and Eldlich the Golden Lord along the way.

Overlaying Pumpking and Changshi into Officiator of Doom Samuel restocks Changshi from the Graveyard, which lets Army of the Haunted Special Summon itself off its own trigger — fueling a Rank-Up into Pumpking the Great Ghost King. Ghost King's on-field effects mill Stare of the Snake Hair and bounce Delta of Invitation back to hand.

Eldlich the Golden Lord revives itself by sending a Call of the Haunted to the Graveyard as cost, then tributes itself to Fusion Summon Fallen Angel of the Golden Land. Call of the Forgotten Sets two more copies of Call of the Haunted from the Deck before the turn closes on an Xyz Summon of The Undying Legion — leaving a Fusion monster, a Rank 7 boss, a live Field Spell, and a fresh trap line all in play.

TCG note: the line runs through Spright Elf, which is Forbidden in the TCG, and uses the one copy of Fiendsmith's Lacrima that the Limited list allows. Starting hand: Fiendsmith Engraver.

comboData.title: One Magician's Rod: Full Backrow (2026)
comboData.description: A one-card line from a single Normal Summon of Magician's Rod, built on the Pharaoh's Servant wave. Rod searches Dark Magical Curtain, Curtain brings out Dark Magician and adds Soul Servant, and that Dark Magician becomes Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant. The Servant Sets Magician's Salvation, Salvation Sets Eternal Soul, and Soul Servant draws you Magicians' Souls, which revives Dark Magician Girl so Salvation can bring the Servant back. You end with Dark Magician of Destruction, Miasma Necromancer, Dark Magician Girl and the Servant, with Salvation active and Eternal Soul Set. Heads-up: this line uses Magicians' Souls, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Dark Time Wizard: Going First Jinzo Lock
comboData.description: Two cards, Alligator's Dragon Knight and Dark Time Wizard, set up a board your opponent can't answer with Traps. The Knight summons itself by revealing Dark Time Wizard and adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Reversal Box. Dark Time Wizard's safe effect adds Swiftwind Panther Warrior and comes back in the End Phase, and Panther turns the Knight into Jinzo - Energy Shocker. comboData.title: Dark Time Wizard: Going Second, Called Right
comboData.description: Going second into a board with monsters and Set Traps. Sleepy Scapegoats brings Tokens and Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes a Token for Jinzo - Energy Shocker, which destroys your opponent's Traps while its lock stops them chaining new ones. Alligator's Dragon Knight adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Foolish Graverobber. Then Dark Time Wizard's coin toss. This line is the right call: your opponent's monsters are destroyed and they take half their original ATK as damage, and the open Exceed procedure adds a 3400-ATK attacker. Exceed, Jinzo, Panther and the Dragon Knight swing for 9,500 before Graceful & Skull Dice adds at least 400 more to each. Exceed's own summon effect needs a Level 8 or lower monster in your hand or Graveyard, and this line has none, so skip it unless you drew one. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats + Dark Time Wizard + Alligator's Dragon Knight. Your Normal Summon stays unused.

comboData.description: The same opening as the called-right line, but Dark Time Wizard's coin toss goes the other way and destroys every monster you control, Tokens included. A monster was still destroyed by Dark Time Wizard, so Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed comes out anyway, by Tributing one of your opponent's monsters. That gets past effects that stop targeting or destruction. Exceed then revives Jinzo - Energy Shocker, and the Trap lock holds because Exceed and the Panther in your Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats + Dark Time Wizard + Alligator's Dragon Knight. Your Normal Summon stays unused.

steps.text: Activate Sleepy Scapegoats.
Special Summon a Sacrificial Sheep Token in Defense Position.
Special Summon the second Sacrificial Sheep Token.

Your opponent controls a monster, so Sleepy Scapegoats also Special Summons Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck. For the rest of the turn it limits what you can summon from the Extra Deck, and Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed still qualifies.
Sleepy Scapegoats goes to the Graveyard.

Tribute a Sacrificial Sheep Token as the cost.

Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned.

Add Foolish Graverobber from your Deck to your hand.

Called wrong. Destroy all monsters you control, starting with your last Token. Don't count on Sleepy Scapegoats here, because its Token is destroyed in the same wipe.
Jinzo - Energy Shocker is destroyed.
Swiftwind Panther Warrior is destroyed.
Alligator's Dragon Knight is destroyed.
Dark Time Wizard goes to the Graveyard. Monsters were still destroyed by Dark Time Wizard, so Exceed's procedure is open.

Your field is empty, so Tribute 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed from your Extra Deck. Tributing doesn't target or destroy, so it gets past effects that only stop those.
Activate effect: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed was Special Summoned.

Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker (Level 7) from your Graveyard. Its Trap-destroying effect is once per turn and already used, but the lock holds: Exceed on your field and Panther in your Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard.
Activate effect: Foolish Graverobber in your Graveyard. Banish it.
Set Sleepy Scapegoats from your Graveyard for your opponent's turn.
Battle Phase: activate Graceful & Skull Dice. Exceed and Jinzo gain the total x 200 ATK, and every monster your opponent still controls loses the same, before you attack.

Attack with Exceed (3400) and Jinzo (2400). Exceed is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell and monster effects, and they still can't activate Traps. Your Normal Summon is unused for Main Phase 2.

comboData.title: Doom-Z Full Combo Line
comboData.description: Going first from DoomZ V Five - Amalthe and Mulcharmy Fuwalos, transcribed move by move from a recorded duel. Amalthe finds Drastea, and Drastea climbs through DoomZ XII End - Drastrius into DoomZ XIII Over - Graflareio. Raiders and Graflareio's floating effect bring out Elara, DoomZ Change and Jupredo, and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. sends Jupredo face-up to the Extra Deck for Terminus. Elara and Amalthe become Springans Merrymaker and then Gigantic "Champion" Sargas, which adds Therion "King" Regulus. Terminus, Vidolium and Vidolia bring out Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction, and DoomZ Change and DoomZ Destruction finish the board. You pass with Sargas, Regulus, Jupiter, a Drastea holding D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G. and Jupredo, DoomZ Raiders and Vidolia face-up, DoomZ Destruction Set and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. in hand.

comboData.title: Endymion Full Combo Line (Advanced)
comboData.description: Advanced full combo line weaving together the Magistus, Spellbook, Witchcrafter, Sky Striker, and Mythical Beast engines. Not recommended for beginners — requires precise sequencing across 200+ steps. This is a specific draw loop variant of the deck, distinct from the standard Endymion line (which ends on multiple negates via Servant → Electrumite → Selene). The core of the draw loop: Royal Magical Library accumulates spell counters from each spell activation and cashes them in for free draws, while Wonder Wand draws 2 by sending itself and its equipped monster to the GY, and Pot of Avarice recycles monsters back into the deck for another two draws — each cycle fuelling the next until you have enough resources to establish the full end board with multiple Endymion bounce negates and set backrow.

comboData.title: Speedroid Terrortop into M-X-Saber Invoker: Double Claudius and Heraklinos
comboData.description: A one-card line from Speedroid Terrortop, with one more card to discard to Flavian. Terrortop and Taketomborg make M-X-Saber Invoker, which brings Gladiator Beast Attorix from the Deck. Test Panther then searches Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts, and a Tri-Brigade engine (Arms Mouser, Kitt, Nervall, Springans Kitt, Shuraig) finds Test Bear. Test Bear summons Gistel and Noxious, which fetch Gladiator Beast's Comeback and set up Vespasius, and those become Tamer Editor. Editor brings out Claudius, and a revived Editor brings out Heraklinos. A second Claudius comes from its own summoning procedure, and Flavian Sets Gladiator Beast Charge in the End Phase. End board: two Claudius (the second can conduct your next Battle Phase twice), Heraklinos with Fraktall and three Triple Tactics Thrust in hand as discards for its negate, and Tri-Brigade Nervall. Starting hand: Speedroid Terrortop + Triple Tactics Talent + 3 Triple Tactics Thrust. The replay's Talent and Thrusts do nothing going first, so any card works as Flavian's discard.

comboData.title: Dragonfly-Centipede Loop into a Triple Xyz End Board

Number 60: Dugares the Timeless is Xyz Summoned early to power the swarm before being spent as Fusion Material, and two copies of Snake-Eyes Doomed Dragon are Fusion Summoned off Inzektor Giga-Mantis and Inzektor Giga-Weevil before themselves becoming the Xyz Material for Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord. The line closes on a three-monster board of Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy, Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord, and Number 3: Cicada King, with Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber left in the Graveyard for follow-up.

comboData.title: Energy Shocker: Alligator's Dragon Knight Push
comboData.description: Going second with two cards. Revealing Energy Shocker Special Summons Alligator's Dragon Knight, whose search sets up Dark Time Wizard and Foolish Graverobber. Dark Time Wizard finds Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes the Dragon Knight for Energy Shocker, and the Dragon Knight in the Graveyard keeps the lock on even if Panther is removed later. Foolish Graverobber then Sets one of the Traps Energy Shocker destroyed onto your field. Starting hand: Alligator's Dragon Knight + Jinzo - Energy Shocker.

cards.name: Any Trap from your opponent's Graveyard

steps.text: Reveal Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your hand. Its text mentions Dark Time Wizard, so Alligator's Dragon Knight can Special Summon itself from your hand.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned. It adds two Spells/Traps with different names that mention Dark Time Wizard.
Add Dark Time Wizard from your Deck to your hand.
Add Foolish Graverobber from your Deck to your hand.
Then discard 1 card: Foolish Graverobber. Its Graveyard effect has no turn restriction, so it's live later this turn.
Activate Dark Time Wizard from your hand and choose its first effect.
It resolves: add Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck to your hand.
Dark Time Wizard goes to the Graveyard. It returns to your hand during the End Phase.
Normal Summon Swiftwind Panther Warrior.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior (Quick Effect). This is your opponent's last chance to chain a Trap.
Tribute Alligator's Dragon Knight as the cost.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your hand.

Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy all Traps your opponent controls (Set cards are revealed first) and gain 300 ATK for each. Panther on the field and Alligator's Dragon Knight in the Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard, so your opponent can't activate Traps in response.
Activate effect: Foolish Graverobber in your Graveyard. Banish it.
Set one Spell/Trap from your opponent's Graveyard to your field, such as a Trap Energy Shocker just destroyed. The lock only stops your opponent, so you can activate it on their turn.
Battle Phase: Energy Shocker and Panther attack (Panther can, because a monster was Tributed this turn). In the End Phase, Dark Time Wizard returns from your Graveyard to your hand.

comboData.title: Endymion Magistus into the Full Fairy Tail Package
comboData.description: A hybrid line that builds the Magistus core off Spell Power Mastery before pivoting into a complete Fairy Tail package. Spell Power Mastery opens Regulus, the Prince of Endymion, which lands Endymion Empire and Verre, the Maid of Endymion; Verre Magic - Lacrima of Light and Witchcrafter Genni fuel Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame. Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden becomes Borreload Savage Dragon, then Spenta and Endymion, the Crescent Magistus feed Magistus Chorozo, Summon Sorceress and Akashic Magician, closing the Magistus half on Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna. From there Fairy Tail - Luna and Matchgiru make Fairy Tail - Wiccat under Fairy Tail Ball, loading Once Upon a Fairy Tail and Tails of the Fairy Tails for Teller of Fairy Tails, a revived Fairy Tail - Snow and a second Wiccat, with Snow banishing the spent Magistus pieces to reset Once Upon a Fairy Tail. Heads-up: this line uses Borreload Savage Dragon, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Twin Dragon Loop into Herald of Mirage Lights
comboData.description:
Continuing the Angwitch opening: Mace revives itself from the Graveyard, mills again, and fuels a second Mementotlan Fusion — bringing back Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King straight out of the GY.

Tecuhtlica's on-summon mill revives Ghattic (who retrieves Shleepy) and banishes itself to activate the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy then special summons itself and fuels a second Fusion into Mementotlan Twin Dragon.

Twin Dragon's own Graveyard trigger sets the field spell off a second time, reviving Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy and chaining through a banished Fusion and Goblin's revival effects.

The line closes by Link Summoning Herald of Mirage Lights, reviving Mementotlan-Horned Dragon and Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation from the Graveyard, and setting Bone Party, Fusion, and Cranium Burst as backrow for next turn.

comboData.title: Memento into Fiendsmith Splash — Necroquip Princess, Ptolemy M7 & Double Desirae
comboData.description:
Same Angwitch-into-Twin Dragon Memento core, splashed into a full Fiendsmith package. After the Mementomictlan field spell revives Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy, Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven into Fiendsmith's Requiem, then tribute Requiem to Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and mill a Fiendsmith Engraver.

Requiem's Graveyard effect fuels a Fusion Summon of Necroquip Princess. The Engraver chain keeps going into an Xyz Summon of Constellar Ptolemy M7, a Fiendsmith's Tract that searches Fabled Lurrie, and a Link Summon of Fiendsmith's Sequence that Fusion Summons Fiendsmith's Desirae.

Sequence and Desirae are sent together to Link Summon Cross-Sheep alongside a revived Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation. Cross-Sheep chains into Lacrima once more to Link Summon A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow.

A Bao A Qu mills Bone Party and banishes itself to Fusion Summon a second Fiendsmith's Desirae. The turn ends with Fusion and Cranium Burst set, plus an active Mementomictlan field spell, for a commanding board-and-backrow presence. Heads-up: this line uses Moon of the Closed Heaven, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Masquerade V Rank-Up Chain: Gorgonic to Chaos Barian Dragon
comboData.description: Going first from Gorgonic Umbral Horror alone. Number 104: Masquerade V needs three Level 4 monsters, but Gorgonic counts as two of them. From there the line climbs Rank 4 to Rank 5 to Rank 7 without a Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Every step is an Xyz Summon that keeps its materials, and C104 Victory picks up Masquerade V's banish effect on the way. Nibiru is live once C104 Victory lands, since it is the fifth summon. The Barian's guide covers the longer Barian's Seventh Untopia version. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror.

comboData.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and two Set cards. Ophrys Scorpio and Byblisp find Bufolicula and Triantis. Triantis places Predator Counters by choosing, not targeting, so the boss's protection doesn't stop them. Daredevil then Tributes the boss as part of its own summon, which starts no chain, and destroys both Set cards. Drosophyllum Hydra Tributes the second monster. Starting hand: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp. Extra Deck: Predaplant Ambulomelides and Predaplant Daredevil. Watch for Ash Blossom on Scorpio and on the three adds, and for Nibiru once Daredevil, your fifth summon, is on the field. A monster that is unaffected by card effects can't get a Predator Counter at all.

comboData.title: Daredevil: Branded Lubellion Break
comboData.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and Set cards. Longinephila is the DARK material for Branded Fusion's Lubellion the Searing Dragon, and Lubellion becomes Mirrorjade. Longinephila's GY effect puts a Predator Counter on the boss without targeting, and Daredevil Tributes it. Mirrorjade banishes the second monster, and the Albion it sends to the GY Sets Branded Banishment in the End Phase. Lubellion and Albion can summon Daredevil (Level 8 or lower), but Branded Banishment and Branded in Red can't (Level 8 or higher). Starting hand: Predaplant Longinephila + Branded Fusion (Limited). Nibiru is live after your fifth summon.

comboData.description: Going second into a board of monsters. Starting hand: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts, Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder and Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms. comboData.title: Cartoon Shade: Sorcerer of the Swamp into Horned Saurus
comboData.description: Two cards, going first or second. Sorcerer of the Swamp turns into Horned Saurus through Kaitoptera and Polymerization. Horned Saurus places Toon Kingdom from the Deck without activating it, so nothing is banished from the Deck, and as an Extra Deck monster it can't be Normal Summoned, which lets Cartoon Shade come out. comboData.description: An explosive 137-step Machine combo piloted by Mirvu starting from Exceptional Schedule and Urgent Schedule. Brings out Morphtronic Telefon and Night Train Blue Traveler to construct Ancient Gear Ballista, Heavy Armored Knight Babeldecker, and Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher into Gadget Gamer. Loops Telefon relentlessly through Power Tool Dragon (searching Overdone Burial), Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon, and Worldsea Dragon Zealantis to repeatedly recycle and tribute Morphtronic Clocken for lethal burn damage in a single turn.

comboData.title: Atlantis: Warchief + Siren Vortex into Neo-Daedalus Rage
comboData.description: Going first with two Beyond the Brave cards. Warchief of Atlantis finds Advent of Atlantis, Advent places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, and Warchief comes back because Advent is named "Umi" on the field. Siren Vortex of Atlantis and Advent's Graveyard search bring out Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. With Atlantis in the Field Zone, Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus needs only 2 materials and Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage only 3. Rage then brings Levia-Dragoon back from the Graveyard, so both of their Quick Effects are ready for your opponent's turn. Starting hand: Warchief of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.

End of the line: Neo-Daedalus Rage (2900), Levia-Dragoon (2600), Levia-Dragon of Atlantis (2600), Monster Arms and Warchief, with Advent of Atlantis and Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon behind them. On your opponent's turn: Rage sends 1 "Umi" to the GY to send every card on the field that isn't "Umi" to the GY (a Quick Effect, once per turn). Levia-Dragoon sends 1 "Umi" in the Main Phase to discard their whole hand and make them draw that many, and nobody can respond. Monster Arms banishes itself and sends 1 "Umi" to negate a monster effect. Every card left on your field except Atlantis is named "Umi", so Rage's sweep leaves your board standing.

Call of Atlantis adds Monster Arms of Atlantis, Siren Vortex sends Advent of Atlantis to the GY for Levia-Dragon of Atlantis, and Levia-Dragon's search sends one of your opponent's cards to the GY without targeting it. Rage brings 3 monsters back, then its Quick Effect sends every card on the field that isn't "Umi" to the GY. Nothing is destroyed and nothing is targeted. Atlantis returns from the GY, Call of Atlantis gives +500 ATK, and three attacks deal 8500. Starting hand: Call of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.
